spec.name: GoldMacdAdxTrendContinuation
spec.hypothesis: XAUUSD is heavily driven by macro flows, central bank accumulation, and institutional hedging. When a strong directional trend is established (ADX > threshold), the market tends to persist in that direction as institutions scale into positions over multiple days. Retail traders frequently attempt to pick tops and bottoms or fade these moves prematurely, becoming trapped liquidity. By waiting for an established trend (ADX) and entering on short-term momentum exhaustion/re-ignition (MACD histogram crossing zero), we align with institutional flow while avoiding the worst of the choppy ranges. The losing side consists of mean-reversion retail traders fading strong macro trends.
spec.entry_logic: Long: ADX > adx_thresh, +DI > -DI, MACD histogram crosses above 0 (from negative to positive), and close > EMA filter. Short: ADX > adx_thresh, -DI > +DI, MACD histogram crosses below 0 (from positive to negative), and close < EMA filter.
spec.exit_logic: Stop loss placed at ATR * sl_mult distance. Take profit placed at ATR * tp_mult distance. Minimum SL is $5.00, minimum TP is $7.50 to ensure valid distances.
spec.expected_failure_conditions: Protracted low-volatility summer chop where ADX stays below threshold or MACD whipsaws around the zero line without follow-through.

details.detail: Bit-identical signal tapes produced on two independent runs with seed=42.
Verified signal identity T_c[0..c] == T_full[0..c] across 20 cut points (tolerance 1e-9).
